# Her Care

> > Women's diagnostic and interventional radiology center in Bangalore offering ultrasound scans, fertility testing (HSG), breast procedures (VABB), and pregnancy care by female specialists.

Her Care operates clinics in Bellandur, Bangalore, led by Dr. Gayathri Priyadharshinee, providing comprehensive women's health diagnostics including fertility treatments, pregnancy scans, and breast health services. The center specializes in interventional radiology procedures with transparent pricing starting from ₹999.
